body.message:
Hello, I hope you’re doing well!

My husband and I are looking for an apartment in Dubai for a short-term rental of 2 months.

Our budget is up to $2,000 per month, and we would ideally like a 1-bedroom apartment with a separate bedroom, living room, and bathroom.

We would like to move in around September 22nd. We are 2 people and we don’t have any pets.

Do you offer short-term rentals for 2 months? If so, could you please send me some available options within our budget?

Thank you!
